acceptanceCriteria: An author can find a stand-in service's URL and its fault-injection route from Corvint alone (fixture repo).
Changing a port offset in the bootstrap is reported as impact on the tests that depend on it.
A test deriving a service address from a hard-coded offset or literal is warned; one using the declared variable is not.
Undeclared or unresolvable derivations are marked unknown, not reliable.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1199. (1) Query: for a named environment profile, the env vars and service endpoints passed to the test process and how each is derived (bootstrap scripts, compose files), marking the ones a test may rely on. (2) Catalog of stand-in service control routes (method, path, payload, scope, teardown) indexed from source. (3) Test-validity warning when a test derives a service address from a hard-coded offset or literal instead of a declared variable. Impact: a bootstrap port-offset change reaches dependent tests.
title: GH #1199: test-process environment contract and stand-in service control-route catalog
